main_text.p: ὁ μετ᾿ αὐτὸν γνώμων Πάπας. Καὶ ἔδηκαν ἅπαντας τὰ ἰδιόχειρα αὐτῶν ἐπάνω τῆς τάφου τῆς ἁγίας Πέτρου τῷ μὴ ἀποδέξασθαί ποτε τὸν μοιχὸν τῆς Ἐκκλησίας Φώτιον, ἢ τὴν χειροτονίαν αὐτοῦ, ἢ τοὺς [?] ἐξορκίας ἀπ[?] τὰς ἱερωμένας δύο Συνόδους αὐτῶν· ὡσαύτως δὲ οἱ Κωνσταντινοπολῖται ἔδηκαν τὰ ἰδιόχειρα αὐτῶν ἐπάνω τῆς ἡμῶν ξύλων, τῷ μὴ κοινωνῆσαί ποτε Φωτίῳ, ἢ τὴν χειροτονίαν αὐτοῦ, ἢ ἀποτῆσαι τὸ ὁμολόγιον Συνόδων τῶν ἐξακολουθησάντων τὰς ἱερωμένας δύο Συνόδους τῶν Ῥωμαίων.

Quin & Romani quo pacto aufi sint violare, quod fuæ manus subscriptione firmarunt? Nam & illi omnes in duabus Synodis Romæ à Nicolao, & Adriano celebratis chirographa ediderunt, quibus Ioannes Archidiaconus, qui Nicolao post Adrianum in Pontificatu successit, manu sua subscripsit. Poterantque omnes chirographa sua supra tumulum S. Petri, testati se Photium Ecclesiæ adulterum, aut ordinationem illius, aut eos, qui dictis duabus Synodis auctoritatem abrogarunt, nunquam receptu-ros. Eodemque modo Constantinopolitani suas subscriptiones super veneranda Crucis lignia posuerunt, iurati, se nunquam cum Photio, aut Photianis communicaturos, Synodumue[?]. Oecumenicam, quæ duas Romanas secuta est, nunquam violaturos.
Quis præterea strophas in hoc facto Photij non agnosceret? Proponunt Legati Pontificij Flauianum Constantinopolitanum§ Ioan-

page.notes: Greek passage at the top is partly unreadable at the scan's resolution; the marked words are best readings. "Synodumue" and "lignia" are as printed and doubtful. The "§" after "Constantinopolitanum" is a printed mark, copied as seen. The last line ends with a hyphenated half word, so the text continues on the next page.
